## Foundry blog — https://devblogs.microsoft.com/foundry/  (read FIRST on Foundry scans)
Only one post in the Aug 14-21 window:
- **Aug 17: "From single call to agents: five new Claude capabilities now available in Microsoft
  Foundry"** (Haoran Cheng) — structured outputs, web search, web fetch, **MCP connector**, and
  **tool search** for Claude models on Azure. Framed as turning "a model endpoint into a production
  agent platform".
  HELD BELOW THE BAR: this is model-capability parity being brought to Claude deployments on a
  Foundry surface this monitor already covers (MCP tooling, web tools and tool search were all
  reported previously in their Foundry/OpenAI forms). No new entity type, endpoint or API.
  Revisit if the Claude MCP connector proves to have a distinct connection object from the managed
  MCP servers / connector-namespace model reported 2026-08-14.

## July 2026 roll-up contents — unchanged, all previously reported or held
New articles: author azure.yaml for hosted agents; **reminder tool for self-scheduling hosted
agents**; Foundry Canvas; **Toolbox overview**; toolbox authentication; use a toolbox with a hosted
agent; Foundry IQ private agentic retrieval tutorials (x2); tool search with the Azure OpenAI
Responses API; Claude models hosting comparison; export hosted agent telemetry via OpenTelemetry;
restrict access to sensitive content in traces; Notification Center overview.
Updated articles: hosted agents; deploy a hosted agent; tool catalog; **managed MCP servers powered
by connector namespaces**; connect to an A2A agent endpoint; **enable incoming A2A**; web search
tool; Foundry IQ; Claude models (x2); WebSocket mode; Realtime API migration; endpoints; evaluate
AI agents; traces-to-dataset; portal GA overview.

Reported 2026-08-14 from this set: incoming A2A endpoints (v0.3 served by DEFAULT when unspecified);
managed MCP servers via connector namespaces (1,000+ connectors, real endpoint on logic.azure.com,
`metadata.type = gateway_connector`, NO gating on the REST/SDK/azd path); sensitive trace content
moving to **`AppGenAIContent`** (values stop being written to AppDependencies/AppTraces/AppEvents
**from 2026-09-30** — HARD DATE, migrate ingestion before then); Foundry Canvas; Notification Center.
